original.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 adds kubelet configuration to the EC2NodeClass v1 API (the spec.kubelet field of karpenter.k8s.aws/v1 EC2NodeClass).

corrected.statement: Karpenter 1.0.0 adds kubelet configuration to the v1 EC2NodeClass API because kubelet moved there from the NodePool. Exposed environments are those whose NodePools set kubelet configuration.

decision.reason: The release note [ev-51e7bc07959c] only announces kubelet configuration on the v1 EC2NodeClass. The upgrade guide says what this means for existing environments: "Kubelet was moved to the EC2NodeClass from the NodePool" [ev-1253ff5bd0a5], as part of the v1 migration to which conversion webhooks apply [ev-bfb089d90d84]. So the exposed environments are those that set kubelet on a NodePool, not every environment that uses the v1 EC2NodeClass. The proposed gvk-in-use condition is too broad and misses the affected group. The NodePool field path spec.template.spec.kubelet is not spelled out in the excerpts, so confidence is low.
